name: Seated knee bends
instructions: Sit tall at the edge of a chair, side-on to the camera. Slowly bend your knee as far as is comfortable, then straighten it fully.

name: Seated knee lifts
instructions: Sit tall, side-on to the camera, feet flat. Lift your knee towards your chest, then set your foot back down.

name: Seated arm raises
instructions: Sit tall, side-on to the camera, arm straight down. Raise your straight arm forward as high as is comfortable, then lower it.

name: Seated elbow bends
instructions: Sit tall, side-on to the camera, arm by your side, palm forward. Bend your elbow to bring your hand up, then straighten it fully.

name: Seated wrist lifts
instructions: Rest your forearm on your thigh, palm down, side-on to the camera. Lift the back of your hand, then lower it gently.
